changelog.title: Create a promo plan
changelog.desc: Have one thing to sell? Answer 3 questions and get a short run of posts with dates, each one leading people to your offer. You see the plan first, then tap Add to my calendar. Find it at the top of the Calendar and the Content Planner, or on any card's Details tab.

changelog.title: Get a post from a link
changelog.desc: In Rebuild in My Voice, paste the link to a post you like and tap Get post. The Studio pulls in the words for you, including the words on every carousel slide, so you never type out slides again. Works with Instagram posts and carousels, blogs, Substack and newsletters.

changelog.title: Shrink, for low energy days
changelog.desc: Open a card, tap Bridge the Gap, then Shrink. You get a tiny version of your post: which format to use, the exact words, and how to make it in about 10 minutes on your phone. Your full version stays on the card.

changelog.title: Hooks got smarter
changelog.desc: Hooks now gives you 3 first lines, each a different way into your idea. If you already wrote your own hook, you also get one line of feedback on it.

changelog.title: Your clients' own words
changelog.desc: Settings, Brand Profile has two new boxes: what clients say when they're stuck, and what they say they wish for. Type a real sentence a client has said. The Studio uses those words to write first lines that sound like your people.

changelog.title: Check my first line
changelog.desc: In Director Chat, tap Check my first line, paste any opening line, and get a quick check plus 3 better ways in. No card needed.

changelog.title: Content cards have a new look
changelog.desc: Each tab now has its own colour and a short how-to at the top. Tap Hide guide to tuck it away. On a computer the card uses the full width, with your hook and notes on one side and your draft on the other.

changelog.title: Settings is tidier
changelog.desc: Every section is now a row you tap to open, and Settings remembers which ones you left open. Brand Profile is split into 3 short steps.

changelog.title: Guides are up to date
changelog.desc: The Studio Guide now covers everything above, with a Try this example for each one.
